statements.quoted:
New York is extending its lead in responsible AI through continued, concrete investment. 🗽

Today, @GovKathyHochul announced the establishment of the Center for AI Responsibility and Research at @binghamtonu as the first-ever independent AI research center at any public university in the United States.

It’s backed by a $30M philanthropic gift led by Bloomberg LP co-founder Tom Secunda, paired with a $25M SUNY research investment, underscoring New York’s exemplary commitment to safe, transparent, and trustworthy AI in the public interest.

Watch the full announcement here: https://t.co/LkrondaV07

statements.text: AI is everywhere and it's here for all of us. I was proud to join @NycAac to honor local students who've dedicated their time to teaching seniors in our community how to use AI safely. In a world where AI is always at our fingertips, everyone deserves to know how to use it, no matter their age.

This week, the leaders of the world’s two leading AI superpowers will meet.

AI is advancing fast—and the world needs clear lines of communication and meaningful guardrails to manage its risks. American leadership and diplomacy can help lead the way.

I joined 28 of my Democratic colleagues to call for a sustained and substantive dialogue with China to address AI-related safety risks.
statements.quoted:
AI governance needs American leadership now more than ever. The U.S. must set the rules of the road through diplomacy, including with China.
